atten3.ptxt: When using SST (TaSCAN) with the ignition switch OFF, repeatedly turn any door courtesy light switch ON/OFF (at intervals of 1.5 seconds or less) until communication between SST (TaSCAN) and the vehicle starts.

step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the [TOP Menu: Diagnosis] → [System Diagnosis: Body] → [System Name: Certification ECU] → [Diagnosis Function: DTC] screen and check the DTCs.

atten4.ptxt: DTCs are output even with the IG OFF.

step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the [TOP Menu: Diagnosis] → [System Diagnosis: Body] → [System Name: Certification ECU] → [Diagnosis Function: DTC] screen and clear the DTCs.
Check the DTCs again, and confirm that the malfunction codes have been cleared and the normal code is displayed.

atten3.ptxt: If a malfunction code is output, repair again according to the code.
